verdict.rationale: Azure documents a public REST API at learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure. The docs cover scripted calls with curl, Microsoft Entra client registration to secure requests, and client libraries for most services. Service-specific APIs such as Cost Management are also documented. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show that no spec sits at the docs-site root paths, which does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths, no independent or hands-on corroboration of REST API use, and the excerpts are thin on breadth of endpoint coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
